title: Oathbringer
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: The third book of the Stormlight Archive, a huge fantasy series about ancient oaths, storms that remake the land and warriors reviving old powers. Here the human war effort strains under a returning enemy, and one commander's past comes under a hard light.
readIf: you are already invested in the Stormlight Archive and want its character backstories and politics to deepen.
skipIf: you haven't read the first two books, since this one leans heavily on them.

pairings.reason: Another sprawling fantasy with a carefully built magic system, though far more focused on a single narrator.
A similarly large, multi-viewpoint war epic where alliances shift, with a much grimmer tone.
A classic long-running epic with the same pleasure of a vast world slowly unfolding across many volumes.
